name: Fluted glass — effect fixture
description: Proving fixture for the fluted-glass Effect (ported to WGSL from @paper-design/shaders fluted-glass, Apache-2.0). Vertical prism flutes refract the pullquote-on-photo substrate — the quote streaks and re-focuses across the ribbed pane, shadow gradients and thin boundary highlights sell the glass material. Full-frame piece (backgroundFill); the alpha contract (E4) masks the pane to the content silhouette by construction. Fixture — exercises the pipeline, not held to the deliverable floors.

content.title: Behind ribbed glass everything is a rumor — shapes survive, edges are negotiable.
